Query:
UNLOAD (SELECT bs.bldg_id AS bldg_id, sum(1) AS metadata_rows_count, count(distinct(bs.bldg_id)) AS model_count, sum(bs.weight) AS units_count, sum(bs."out.electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" * bs.weight) AS "electricity.total.energy_consumption..kwh" FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.applicability = true AND bs.upgrade = 0 AND (bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state) IN (SELECT bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state FROM comstock_amy2018_r2_2025_md_by_state_and_county_parquet AS bs WHERE bs.upgrade IN (1, 11) AND bs.applicability = true AND bs.state = 'CO' GROUP BY bs.bldg_id, bs."in.nhgis_tract_gisjoin", bs.state HAVING count(distinct(bs.upgrade)) = 2) AND bs.state = 'CO' AND bs.bldg_id IN (46369, 46370, 46381, 46382, 46803, 46813, 46897, 46898) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1) 
 TO 's3://resstock-core/bsq_athena_unload_results/202d060b2f57f0d085841978f13ac0ccfcf966c980dd50e047026bc0e7991133/17d48376-bef4-4947-98ee-4bf9858fc8db/'
